description: Default demo stand -- support channel, storefront, one agent chain
_notes: WHAT THIS PROFILE IS FOR: after `aivis seed` on a clean stand an
investor can sign in and open a support request, and a support
staff member can sign in, see the queue and answer. Everything
else here exists to make those two screens non-empty.
demo_password IS A FIXTURE, NOT A SECRET, and the admin uses it
too. This is the TEST server's repository, there is no production
stand seeded from here, and `aivis seed` refuses a production
contour outright -- so a separate admin secret would protect
nothing and cost a prompt plus an environment variable.
NO DATES ANYWHERE. Nothing in this profile takes a caller-chosen
date through its application path; see the seed.py header.
distribution_config is the minimal valid one: the company keeps
everything and no agent level pays out. The agent below therefore
has a link and a referred investor but earns no commission -- the
referral CHAIN is what this profile demonstrates, not the money.
package_size must fit the pool: total_supply 1000000 at
equity_percent 10 gives 100000 options, and the three packages
